requirement:
重构配置管理和车站信息服务的接口实现。
配置服务和车站服务的接口返回格式不统一。
需要统一两个服务的接口规范并更新下游调用方。

details.name: ts-station-service
details.rationale: Requirement explicitly mentions unifying interface specs for config and station services, so station service likely needs changes.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service likely queries station and config services for trip information, so it may need to align with new response formats.

details.name: ts-admin-basic-info-service
details.rationale: Admin basic info service likely consumes config and station APIs for administrative views, so it may need updates to match new response formats.
